As someone who has been a candidate in seven election campaigns and been involved in several
dozen other campaigns, I wanted to take the opportunity to express my support for the
region's existing sign by-law as it pertains to banning election signs along regional roads.
Under the old by-law, candidates had to post signs on public property to be seen as competitive.

for candidates wanting to enter the race who may have had limited financial resources or fundraising
capacity. Signs along public roadways aren't really an indication of support. Rather, they are
an indication of the financial resources that candidates have. It's better to limit signage
to that which is requested by property owners or on lawns, balconies, or windows.
